info.title: AI Predictive Maintenance API
info.description:
Predict industrial equipment failures from sensor data, explain each prediction
and recommend maintenance.

**Auth:** `POST /api/v1/auth/login` returns a bearer access token (15 min) and sets
an httpOnly refresh cookie. Roles: `viewer` < `engineer` < `admin`.

**Errors** use RFC 9457 problem details (`application/problem+json`).

schema.title: Response List Users Api V1 Users Get

delete.description: Soft delete: users are deactivated, never removed, to preserve audit history.

schema.title: Response List Types Api V1 Equipment Types Get

delete.description: Hard delete (cascades readings and predictions). Admin only; prefer status='retired'.

post.description:
Ingest up to ``PDM_MAX_BATCH_READINGS`` readings. Invalid rows are rejected and
reported; valid rows are stored. A re-score is queued if a model is active.

Upload a CSV (``equipment_serial,sensor,ts,value``). The file is streamed to
disk with a size limit, the header is checked immediately, and the rows are
imported by the background worker. Poll ``GET /ingestion/batches/{id}``.

post.description: Score the equipment synchronously with the active model and store the result.

schema.title: Response List Jobs Api V1 Models Jobs Get

get.description: Side-by-side comparison. MTBF = observed days / failures over the last year (None if no failures).

schema.title: Response Compare Api V1 Analytics Compare Get

get.description:
Deterministic expected-value estimate (not an ML prediction):
expected failure cost = P(failure within horizon) × average historical corrective
repair cost for that equipment type; compared with the average cost of an early
(planned) repair. Acting is suggested when the expected failure cost is higher.

put.description: New thresholds apply to future predictions; past predictions are not re-labelled.
